## Detailed Skill Matrix

### 1. Frontend Development

- **TypeScript**: Strict Type Safety, Interfaces, Generics, Component Prop Typing.
- **UI & Styling**: Tailwind CSS, CSS Grid/Flexbox, Custom Design Systems, Responsive Layouts, Dark Mode Aesthetics.

### 2. Creative Development & Motion
- **Three.js & React Three Fiber**: 3D Canvas, Shaders, Mesh Manipulations, Orbit Controls, Custom Render Loops.
- **GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform)**: ScrollTrigger, Timeline Orchestration, Micro-interactions, Morphing SVG, Complex Sequence Animation.
- **Framer Motion**: Gesture Animations, Layout Animations, AnimatePresence, Scroll-driven Motion.
- **Lenis**: Smooth scrolling engine integration.

### 3. Backend & Tooling
- **Node.js / Express**: RESTful API design, server-side data processing, integration with email services (Nodemailer).
- **Deployment**: Vercel CI/CD deployment, custom domain routing, environment variable management.
